title: Out-of-Pocket Share on a Re-Billed Cash Fill under Prescription Insurance on File
content:
Under **Prescription Insurance on File**, a patient kept out of pocket earns an out-of-pocket share when a cash fill is re-billed. The wait runs in calendar days from the date the cash fill was dispensed, as the Prescriptions fill ledger records it, to the day of the re-bill.

## Rule

- Dispensed more than **10** days before the day of the re-bill: the charge is multiplied by **0.9**.
- Dispensed **4** to 10 days before: the charge is multiplied by **0.95**.
- Otherwise: the charge is multiplied by 1.

The share multiplies the unrounded charge; the amount is rounded to the cent only at the end.

## Input, judgement, output (hypothetical: re-bill on 20 June)

| Cash fill dispensed | Days before 20 June | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| 18 June | 2 | 1 |
| 17 June | 3 | 1 |
| 16 June | 4 | 0.95 |
| 10 June | 10 | 0.95 |
| 9 June | 11 | 0.9 |
